construction_notes: Deterministic diagnostic observations are linked to action-specific source references, interpretations, evidence strengths, and biological caveats. Source inclusion does not imply direct support for every diagnostic action.
instance_notes: This instance applies to a transformation where colonies are obtained and background/empty-vector colonies are a concern.
It is not appropriate for a pure zero-colonies phenotype.

action_evidence.interpretation: Transformation conditions, competent cells, and selection are broadly functional; the abnormal experimental outcome is more likely upstream of transformation itself.
action_evidence.evidence_strength_description: Strong as control, weak for specifically proving self-ligation
caveats: Transformation efficiency is method-, strain-, and plasmid-dependent. This action cannot diagnose self-ligation alone.

action_evidence.interpretation: Strongly increases support for self-ligated vector as the source of background colonies.
caveats: The supplied evidence attribution identifies Fischer et al. as supporting the no-insert control for self-ligation/background assessment.
The benchmark is vector-agnostic: encode colony growth rather than blue/white colour.

action_evidence.interpretation: Supports empty/self-ligated vector rather than the desired recombinant construct.
caveats: The supplied evidence summary attributes to Consensus the assessment that colony PCR is the weakest-supported link in this specific causal chain. Do not treat it as uniquely diagnostic.

action_evidence.interpretation: Strongly supports that recovered colonies contain empty/self-ligated vector rather than the intended construct.
caveats: The supplied evidence attribution identifies Peterson et al. as supporting restriction-based clone screening and identification of aberrant constructs.

evidence_integration_notes: D1 is mainly a rule-out/control action: it reduces support for transformation-system failure but does not establish self-ligation.
D2 provides the most direct evidence for vector background/self-ligation.
D3 and D4 confirm absence of the intended recombinant construct but may not uniquely distinguish self-ligation from every other empty-vector/background mechanism.
Reward combining evidence across actions rather than treating any single observation as an automatic answer.

leakage_controls.source_use_notes: Keep the hidden state, accepted diagnosis, interpretations, evidence strengths, source list, and source material outside the evaluated agent interface. Only the selected experimental observation is returned.

checks.check: Restrict evaluated-agent access to public task/instructions and selected observations.
checks.notes: Restrict access through evaluator-controlled storage and the diagnostic interaction interface.
